description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by Make Distiller Fast; ruling "4. here": built by MDF; "1. yes": recipes carry no validation of their argument). Page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.213.html (https://claude.ai/artifact/43TCc8n3pvfcRFma5hsxDo). Supersedes the original step-3 scope (a table of fz_op_*_ii externs only).

Scope: one recipe table in native_codegen/recipe.rs keyed by runtime symbol, consulted by both runtime_call1! and the lib-extern lowering. A row names a runtime function and its inline instructions; three result shapes: Value, Condition (a branch condition, not a boolean atom), Checked (overflow/failure tested as a branch, replacing decode_pair_result + strict_bool + value_truthy). Recipes do no argument validation. The Rust function stays the definition (interpreter); one parity test walks the table.

First rows: fz_type_of, fz_truthy_ref, fz_unbox_int, fz_unbox_atom, fz_struct_schema_id_ref, fz_value_eq_raw_const, integer add/sub/mul/neg, integer and float comparisons. Superseded hand-written kind/address extraction is removed.

Evidence (MDF census, bench, develop 394fa1313, 5 alternated runs, output identical): five hottest compiler-emitted calls (fz_type_of 73.8M calls, fz_value_eq_raw_const 73.6M, fz_truthy_ref 17.5M, fz_struct_schema_id_ref 17.0M, fz_unbox_int 14.0M) inline: -8.57% instr / -6.50% cycles; plus integer arithmetic with overflow as a branch: -9.12% / -6.67%. The typed lib comparisons (fz_op_lt_ii etc.) are only 1.5M calls.

Acceptance: interp, JIT and AOT agree; parity test green; pins that fall are lowered, none rises; full gate.

comments.text: No longer blocked by fz-sc8.212 (parked). The splice (emit_extern_call) knows which extern it emits; the instruction table keys on that. Measured on top of the splice: distiller no change, p1b -1.2%, p2b -3.0%.

Fresh evidence (Optimize, release AOT disassembly of spin/2 on b237ec0a0 + #674): `def spin(0, acc), do: acc; def spin(n, acc), do: spin(n - 1, acc + n)` runs ~93 instructions per iteration. The clause body (~77) calls _fz_op_sub_ii and _fz_op_add_ii (each `adds/subs; cset w1,vs; ret`, runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:949 integer_arithmetic_export!), each followed by 11 instructions decoding the overflow flag into a branch; the two calls are why the clause saves/restores 9 callee-saved registers. Binary: GC scratch 9x7-14/b-V0/spin.bin.

Coordination note: fz-nml.8 (JSON session, building) renames runtime fz_bs_write_int (runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs) into a scalar-word writer that also takes floats, and edits native_codegen/prim.rs bitstring construction. Whoever builds this ticket rebases on it.

Fresh evidence (MDF runtime hunt, develop 1438c8bfa, bench): integer +, -, * compile to an out-of-line call per operation (lib/kernel.fz:969 -> extern fz_op_add_ii, runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:956) plus 13 instructions testing the failure flag: 38 instructions per byte on the byte-walk probe, no cycles today (the 20.3 cycles/byte are serial register-pair pushes/pops across dispatch and __clause_0; see ../fz-sc8.byte-walk-loop.html). MDF proposed this as "Integer add, subtract and multiply are emitted inline": it is this ticket.

title: Runtime calls the compiler emits are inlined from one recipe table
